citations.title: Chinese E-Commerce Giant JD.Com Soars as First Female CEO Takes the Reins

sentences.text: Sandy Ran Xu has served as chief executive officer and executive director of JD.com, Inc. since May 2023, after serving as the company's chief financial officer from June 2020 to May 2023.
She joined JD.com in July 2018, overseeing group finance, accounting and tax functions and serving as chief financial officer of JD Retail from July 2018 to May 2020.

Before JD.com she was an audit partner, spending nearly 20 years with PricewaterhouseCoopers Zhong Tian LLP in Beijing and PricewaterhouseCoopers in San Jose, and she was a Certified Public Accountant in both China and the United States.
She holds a bachelor's degree from Peking University with a double major in information science and economics.
She also serves as an independent director of Baidu, Inc.
